pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with jagged, high-contrast edge gradients. The geometries on the flank are larger and more angular, while patches on the neck and shoulder area exhibit reduced spatial area and increased proximity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored network with varying pixel thickness, generally wider on the lower flank and narrower on the neck. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial with sharp vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck line with a consistent, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Oxpecker birds (Buphagus sp.) perched on the neck and shoulder region, which obscure small sections of the dorsal mane and lateral pelage.
